entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, if you keep modelin', maybe[n]you'll get on TV someday.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann on TV...!? The views would[n]go through the roof!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But... If she gets super popular, she'll[n]end up in the crosshairs of more than[n]a few unsavory characters...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not to worry, Lady Ann! I'll protect you!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell are you talkin' about, man?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, if that happens, I'll be sure to hire[n]you as my bodyguard.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, you're so lucky... The moment you[n]show up on TV, the crowd goes wild.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's not as great as you may think.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: With this much attention on me, I need[n]to constantly consider how the audience[n]and media will interpret my words.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Media, huh... Screw 'em. Why can't you[n]just say whatever you damn well please?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Hiii, everybody~ I'm the super cool,[n]super hot Detective Prince, Goro Akechi![n]Single and ready for fan mail, teehee!"

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Like that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...You poor soul.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hrrrgh, I don't need your pity!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey Sumire, weren't you interviewed[n]for gymnastics and stuff like that?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: With my sister, yes... but I can't say I[n]enjoyed it very much.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaaat, why not? I've always wanted[n]to be interviewed on TV.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You already have been, though... I'm[n]sure you know what I mean.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If it's this hot in Julyyy, can you imagine[n]just how insane the weather's gonna be[n]in Deceeember?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, all right! I'm sorry!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What IS this gaudy place? It hurts my[n]eyes.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It's as if a site has been plucked from[n]reality and placed here as decoration.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Almost like the realm in which we[n]reside...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Does that mean there are inmates here[n]too? Wouldn't they lose their minds?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps that is precisely the plan. Trap[n]them in unbearable locations like this[n]and slowly wear away at their sanity.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: How horrifying... I guess we've been[n]pretty nice, huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey Sis, do you remember when you[n]first became a prosecutor?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They ran a story about you on TV.[n]Everyone was talking about how[n]beautiful you are.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Yes... That was quite a nuisance, to be[n]honest. They were writing articles about[n]me that weren't even true.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I suppose they couldn't think of anything[n]better than vapid claims of me falling in[n]love with a colleague.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Heh... Yeah.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Something the matter?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... Um, I've just been wondering what[n]kind of person was your type.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I see... How about this? I'll tell you if[n]you tell me.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Is there someone you've taken a[n]liking to?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh!? Well, um...
